speaker: john_heminges
text: The door is shut. The Shrew is done, and you were not in it, Will. We are seven, and the book is open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you shall have him word for word. The court removes to Richmond today, my lord with it. Sir Thomas's place is not filled. His lady must render the accounts before any man signs a new one. The Chamber pays nobody till then.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the being sent for. Say that plainly, Will, before John makes it shorter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will be sent for. Whether you will be paid for is a question for another office. My lord says the Queen's debt is the best in England, and he says it with oaths Kettleby will not carry.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And the king. He was asked the king. I would hear that before we spend the shoes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My lord has heard of it from four persons and disliked none of the reports. That is all he is to say. He said so.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The— the matter stands thus. If we're sent for, we go. A company that asks the Queen for money down is a company that's not sent for twice.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Say it again, John. I heard it, and I should like it twice, since it is the only sentence here that does not hope for a purse.

speaker: john_heminges
text: If we're sent for, we go. A company that asks the Queen for money down is a company that's not sent for twice.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I will stand with John. I know which door to ask at, and I will not ask it for a sum that has not been written.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What it will cost, if we are named, is the boat up, the lodging, and the boys' meat for five days. The stock holds six pound. Six pound will carry the going. It is not a receipt.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Six pound, Sweet Master Shakespeare, is a very tidy nothing to put into a man's hand at Richmond.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Last year three men were named, and they fetched it in a morning. This year whoever is named will wear out a pair of shoes between Whitehall and wherever the Chamber sits.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I was first on the—

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let the grocer be first. He likes a passage to wait in.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast stopped in the right place. A first name on a paper is a first pair of shoes.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And you were paid before Easter. Ah, the old days.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was second on the Queen's paper once, Dick. It was the only time I was ever read aloud. I am not asking thee to put me second again.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nobody in this room is asking to be named. That is how a thing of this kind gets settled.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Settled by nobody wanting it. John and I will be the two who stand where a door is, when a door is offered. Not before.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Let us first discover whose money we are spending. It is not ours until a man signs, and no man can sign.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we do not write a day, and we do not write a figure. Thou canst keep a Christmas in thy book, Will, if thou wilt keep the column empty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can, and I thank thee. I will write that it is expected. I will not write what is not received.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You write the empty column, and the grocer waits in the passage. I find I can live with both.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Live with it, then. The old days paid before Easter. These days have shoes in them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys eat whether we are sent for or not. Five days of their meat sits inside John's six pound, and not a day beyond it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And if we are not sent for, the six pound stays in the stock. I will not hear it spent by a hopeful sentence.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It will not be spent. The book shuts on the question. It does not shut on a sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done. God keep the shoes that have not been walked through yet.
